facts.statement: At 06:55 on 13 March 2026 the network monitor reported switch SW-2B on floor 2 unreachable.
At 07:04 Avery Lindqvist badged through lobby turnstile 1 with her own card.
At 07:12 card A-2291 opened Network Room N-3.
The badge database lists card A-2291 as assigned to Rafael Haddad.
Haddad was on approved leave from 9 to 20 March 2026.
Lindqvist's own N-3 access was removed at 17:00 on 12 March because her annual access recertification training was overdue.
Lindqvist power-cycled SW-2B in N-3, and it was reachable again at 07:26.
Lindqvist was the only Infrastructure Support staff member in the building before 07:30.
Lindqvist has been on a performance improvement plan since February 2026.
Lindqvist was the on-call IT technician on 13 March.
Lindqvist opened incident ticket INC-0313-004 at 07:30.
Card A-2291 was deactivated for Haddad on 28 February when his photo card was replaced, and moved to the IT lockbox spare pool on 1 March.
When A-2291 moved to the spare pool, the holder name in the badge database was not updated (backlog ticket BA-118).
At 07:09 Lindqvist signed spare card A-2291 out of the IT lockbox under outage procedure OP-7.
Lindqvist returned spare card A-2291 to the lockbox at 07:41.
INC-0313-004 records that SW-2B was power-cycled in N-3 using lockbox spare card A-2291 under OP-7.
Lindqvist does not know that card A-2291 was once Haddad's card.
Haddad left his personal badge, card A-2291, with Lindqvist on 6 March so she could collect a parcel from his desk while he was on leave.
Lindqvist used Haddad's personal badge, card A-2291, to open N-3 at 07:12.
Lindqvist wanted SW-2B back online before her manager arrived at 08:00 because she is on a performance improvement plan.
The IT lockbox sign-out sheet has no entry for 13 March.
Card A-2291 is active and assigned to Haddad; approved leave does not deactivate cards.
INC-0313-004 records that SW-2B was power-cycled in N-3 but does not say how Lindqvist entered N-3.
After the reboot Lindqvist put Haddad's badge back in her desk drawer.
